# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.title }} ({{ site.short_name }}) is a {{ site.location | split: ',' | first }} software studio founded in {{ site.founding_year }} by {{ site.founder }}. It designs and builds agentic AI systems, meaning AI agents and multi-step pipelines that read a company's documents and data and return finished work, along with web and mobile products and the interfaces around them.

- Lead capability: agentic AI development. Agents read source documents, extract the work, draft the deliverable, and check it against the source before handing it off.
- In production: SiteSpecs AI, agentic AI for construction with twelve pipelines, including bid scopes, RFP responses, submittal reviews, CPM schedules, and safety audits.
- Location: {{ site.location }}. Works with teams remotely.
- Contact: {{ site.email }} or {{ '/#contact' | absolute_url }}
